Consider two samples of size $n_{x} = 8$ and $n_{y} = 11$ from two independent normal populations $X$ and $Y$ having population variances $σ_{x}^{2}$ and $σ_{y}^{2}$, respectively. Unbiased estimates of the population variances obtained from these two samples are $s_{x}^{2} = 1.5^{2}$ and $s_{y}^{2} = 1.3^{2}$. We wish to carry out a hypothesis test at a $5%$ significance level to test the hypothesis $H_{0}: σ_{x}^{2} = σ_{y}^{2}$ against the alternative $H_{1}: σ_{x}^{2} > σ_{y}^{2}$.
